description: This file provides a wrapper class for interacting with Supabase's admin REST API using httpx, enabling actions such as creating users, generating links, signing in, and updating passwords. It is designed to be used as part of an authentication backend system.

classes.name: SupabaseAdminClient
classes.description: A minimal wrapper for Supabase admin REST API, focusing on user management and authentication actions.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _headers(self)
methods.description: Generates the request headers including the required API key and authorization token.

methods.name: str _auth_url(self, path: str)
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for a given API endpoint path.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_user(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user in Supabase Auth via admin API.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] generate_link(self, email: str, link_type: str, redirect_to: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Generates a magic or verification link for a user via admin API.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] password_sign_in(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Performs password-based sign-in, returning authentication tokens.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] admin_update_password_by_email(self, email: str, new_password: str)
methods.description: Updates a user's password in Supabase by email.
